lyrics.text: ♪ (Lofi vinyl crackle & electric piano intro) ♪
Midnight raindrops tapping on the glass
Neon glow reflecting softly as the shadows pass
Warm steam rising from a porcelain cup
Lost in twilight hours, never looking up
Feel every beat, let the calm take hold
Every quiet second worth its weight in gold
♪ (Smooth chillhop groove & sub-bass pulse) ♪
Lines of code and city lights below
Moving to a rhythm steady and slow
Feel every beat... live every moment.
♪ (Gentle fading guitar outro) ♪
♪ (Punchy 80s analog synth arpeggio) ♪
Accelerating down the cyber expressway
Chrome reflections fading in the purple spray
Twin turbochargers breathing in the night
Chasing after visions in synthetic light
Neon Horizon, tearing through the grid!
Never look behind at what the darkness did
♪ (Heavy driving synthwave drop & drums) ♪
Speed of light, zero gravity
PreZify frequency setting us free!
Racing towards tomorrow on the edge of sound
♪ (Analog brass crescendo & outro) ♪
♪ (432Hz harmonic drone & celestial bells) ♪
Floating past stellar dust and ancient rings
Listening to what the boundless silence sings
Weightless drift across the cosmic sea
A timeless breath of pure serenity
Echoes of light across the starry night
Hold the vibration, sacred and bright
♪ (Deep resonant reverb fading into stars) ♪
♪ (Deep house four-on-the-floor beat buildup) ♪
Solar flare charging through the atmosphere
Signals locked in, crystal sharp and clear
Pulse on the floor, bass in your chest
Energy unbounded, put your soul to the test
Feel the surge, drift into the sun!
♪ (Massive club drop with vibrating sub-bass) ♪
Solar Drift... keep the cadence high
Electric thunder rolling through the sky
♪ (High-energy filter sweep & rhythm) ♪
♪ (Acoustic jazz chords & soft drum brushes) ♪
Sipping cinnamon tea by the corner booth
Old paperback novels telling timeless truth
Raindrops race each other on the window glass
Watching all the hurried strangers swiftly pass
Take a breath, slow down the ticking hands
Music understands what no one understands
♪ (Sweet saxophone solo with soft rhodes) ♪
Stay here awhile, let the cozy warmth remain
In harmony with the soft November rain
♪ (Gentle chime outro) ♪
♪ (Aggressive modular synth pulse & glitch drums) ♪
Neural uplink connected, speed unlimited
Every synapse sparking, consciousness transmitted
Through dark matter storms and laser skies
Look into the starlight through robotic eyes
Velocity maximum, breaking sound barriers!
♪ (Heavy industrial cyber drop) ♪
PreZify hyper-drive activated
♪ (Glitch fade & cosmic echo) ♪
♪ (Cowbell melody & heavy 808 distortion) ♪
Drifting through the midnight neon rain
Adrenaline rushing straight into the vein
Run phonk energy, feeling the raw speed
PreZify bass is all that you need
♪ (Aggressive phonk drop & distorted 808s) ♪
Smoke on the asphalt, tires screeching loud
♪ (Slow fade out with dark atmospheric synth) ♪
♪ (Heavy bass drop & aggressive phonk rhythm) ♪
Midnight runners speeding through the rain
Night Edition overdrive, breaking through the pain
Feel the engine roar under neon sky
♪ (Dark phonk cowbell solo & distorted 808 drop) ♪
Push the limits, never slowing down
PreZify sound echoes across the town
♪ (Smooth outro fade) ♪
♪ (Soulful melodic intro & acoustic flute) ♪
Radhimaa... sacred rhythm in the breeze
Melodies that put the heart and soul at ease
A journey through the divine harmonies
♪ (Grand instrumental crescendo & rhythm) ♪
Feel every beat... live every moment with Radhimaa
Peaceful resonance echoing through time
♪ (Peaceful closing flute outro) ♪
